column3: The manager had to reject my request for a vacation. (經理不得不拒絕我的休假申請。)
Do not fail to call me when you arrive home. (你到家時千萬別忘了打電話給我。)
I suspect that the meeting will be moved to tomorrow. (我懷疑會議會改到明天舉行。)
We need to check our office supply before ordering more. (我們在訂購更多之前，需要先檢查辦公室用品庫存。)
The CEO decided to resign after ten years of service. (執行長在任職十年後決定辭職。)
The company faced a big scandal regarding its financial reports. (該公司面臨了一起關於財務報告的重大醜聞。)
Our team managed to capture the first prize in the competition. (我們的團隊成功贏得了比賽的第一名。)
I made a promise to finish the report by Friday. (我承諾會在週五前完成報告。)
I have a missing file on my computer desktop. (我的電腦桌面上遺失了一個檔案。)
I need to search for a new apartment near the station. (我需要搜尋車站附近的新公寓。)
